summary: Feed 'duplicates' to IDS is degraded due to 13.0% duplicate packets (464/3573, threshold 5%). No other visibility faults detected (no drops, overload, one-way, VLAN or encryption issues).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating overlapping SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication - same packet seen on multiple ingress ports forwarded twice to IDS tool port. Common when two SPAN sessions or dual TAP feeds cover same link and are aggregated.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU/capacity processing 13% duplicate packets, inflates connection state and event counts, risks false positives and missed detections due to duplicate TCP reassembly and signature matching overhead.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet broker deduplication to drop identical packets within dedup window before delivery to 1Gbps IDS port, restoring complete correct traffic without wasting IDS resources.
